03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that builds a reference dashboard for one Fusion command or CAM toolpath dialog, such as 2D Offset Roughing, Adaptive Clearing or Extrude. It starts from a parameter JSON (tabs, then groups, then parameter names, in dialog order) and the URL of the command's Autodesk product-documentation page. Swami makes that JSON with a command in the Autodesk Assistant AI inside Fusion.

Claude researches the help page and writes a notes.json with a plain-language description and a tip for every parameter, plus a glossary. The skill's build script embeds both JSON files in the page, and the page renders itself in the browser. That is what lets its Input section load a different JSON or URL and rebuild every data-driven section, with descriptions carried over wherever names match. Like every vibe-dashboard, it also has Search, a Mind Map, a Glossary and an audio overview.

Why it mattersA Fusion dialog can hold a hundred settings spread over several tabs. One page that lists every parameter where it lives, explains it, and links to Autodesk's own reference makes a command much faster to learn and to look things up in.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Asks FirstRun with no inputs, it builds nothing and asks for the parameter JSON and the help-page URL.
  • Normalises InputConverts a JSON of another shape to operation plus tabs, and says how. Given only a URL, it tries to read the page and builds the JSON from its headings, showing it before building.
  • Writes NotesWrites what each parameter does and a tip, a description for each group, and an intro, cross-reference, focus and use-when line for each tab, usually plus a step-by-step setup workflow section.
  • Parameter MapA Parameter Map at a Glance section with a tabs table and a table of every group and its parameters.
  • Hierarchy TreeA collapsible tree of command, tab, group and parameter, with sticky level buttons, jump links to each table row, and hover tooltips.
  • Tab SectionsOne section per dialog tab, with a table per group. A uniform tab, where every group has the same few fields (like Heights), gets one table instead.
  • Input SectionLets a viewer load another parameter JSON (file or paste) and URL; the page saves it in that browser and rebuilds. "reset to original" goes back to the built-in JSON.
  • References and SourceLinks to the Autodesk help page and any other sources, and shows the parameter JSON verbatim.
  • Search, Mind Map, Glossary, AudioAdds vibe-dashboard's Search section, Mind Map, table fitting and a Glossary, plus a spoken audio overview that hides itself when another command is loaded through Input.
  • ChecksTests the page in a headless browser at two widths: no page errors or colour clashes, every tree link lands on a table row, tables fit, summary rows link, and every glossary term is used.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Any CommandDocuments any Fusion command or toolpath dialog, from design features to CAM operations.
  • Every ParameterGives every parameter a description and a tip, in dialog order.
  • Reusable PageThe Input section turns one published page into a viewer for other commands' JSON, with no rebuild.
  • Easy NavigationThe hierarchy tree jumps straight to any tab, group or parameter row.
  • Easy to Find ThingsSearch, the Mind Map and the Glossary make every parameter quick to find.
  • Thin Help Pageshelp.autodesk.com pages are script-heavy and can come back thin; then the notes rely on general Fusion knowledge and say so.
  • Loaded CommandsA command loaded through Input only gets descriptions where names match the original; extras and the custom intro are hidden.
  • Browser MemoryWhat Input loads is remembered only in that browser.
  • JSON Command UndocumentedThe Autodesk Assistant command that makes the parameter JSON isn't written down in the skill yet.
  • Audio for One CommandThe audio describes the original command, so it hides when another command is loaded through Input.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill doesn't need, create or get run by a scheduled task. Its pages are backed up nightly like every other artifact, and the nightly Skill Library refresh packages the skill as a zip.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Narration SourceThe sections are drawn in the browser, so the narration outline comes from a rendered copy of the page, made with a short Playwright command in the skill.
  • Glossary MatchesGlossary terms must appear in descriptions, tips or intros; parameter and group names never link, so they don't count.
  • No InputsRun with nothing attached, it must ask and wait, never build an example page.
  • JSON ShapeEvery group must be a non-empty list of parameter names; anything else is rejected, in the build and in the Input section.
  • Uniform TabsA tab whose groups all share the same four or fewer fields becomes one table, so notes for it take a typical value, not a description and tip.
  • Fresh TemplateAlways rebuild from a fresh template copy; the script refuses a copy it already built.
  • Don't Hand-editSections are rendered from the embedded JSON at load time, so hand edits to the HTML are lost. Recover the JSON from the published page if the scratchpad is gone.
